fast_cuts.name: Fast Cuts
fast_cuts.description: Quick, energetic cuts synced to beats. Great for travel, gym, and party content.

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.description: Smooth, longer shots with crossfades. Perfect for landscapes and cinematic vlogs.

vlog_energy.name: Vlog Energy
vlog_energy.description: Medium-paced with emphasis on faces and expressions. Ideal for talking-head and daily vlogs.

aesthetic.name: Aesthetic

hype.name: Hype / Sports
hype.description: Ultra-fast cuts with heavy beat sync. For sports, fitness, and action content.
